Name: SDV Argenti Mod (HSR)
Author: SukuroIsUseless
Description:
[center]﻿[/center]
[center][size=5][b]Adds Argenti to Stardew Valley!
[/b][/size][i]If you have any feedback or suggestion[size=3]s for this mod, don't[/size] be afraid to post them!
[/i][size=2]11/22: Currently cannot work on updates or bug fixes that relate to SVE, to put it in short.[/size]

[/center]


[size=3]Argenti is a follower of a goddess from a foreign land that has settled down in Pelican Town, taking upon the role of a florist. Once someone who traveled across the globe preaching the word of said goddess, he seems to have given up that life for one reason or another...[/size]




[size=3][u]If you notice any bugs, spelling mistakes, missing punctuation, or conflicting dialogue, please let me know!
[/u][/size]
[center]~~﻿
[/center]
This mod was designed around [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], thus his placements reflect the changes that SVE makes, but it IS compatible without it. However, I cannot recall if I dealt with everything,., so [b]if you don't use any mods that alter the vanilla locations and you see him standing inside any objects, tell me!

[/b]Having the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url] mod installed will add more inventory to Argenti's shop, give him 5 more loved gifts, and make more flowers available in his garden, but it is not required.

Having the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url] mod is recommended, since the style of his sprites are based around those + he has seasonal outfits.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9222]Eugene[/url], which is worth mentioning since Eugene's house is in the same area as Argenti's house when you have SVE. You need to manually relocate Argenti's house in the config menu instead of it just happening automatically now.

Argenti Roses and other flowers will be unable to spawn in Argenti's garden without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url], but the mod should work fine without it.

[b]Not[/b] compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Cape Stardew[/url] if you are using SVE, Eugene, and Cape Stardew all at the same time, as there will be no place for his house's default or alternate location.

Compatibility with Rumirumm's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27478]Boothill Mod[/url] is not included in the base mod. You can check the mod author's social media for the patch if you want it.

[center]﻿~~
[/center]
[left]﻿This Mod Adds:[/left]
[list]
[*][size=3][b][i]Argenti as a fully fledged NPC![/i][/b][/size][/*]
[/list]  [size=2]His dialogue, sprites, and portraits were all made by me.
﻿He even has seasonal outfits, plus one festival outfit so far![/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][b][i]Events![/i][/b][/size][/*]
[/list]  [size=2]Currently, Argenti has all of his Heart Events[/size][size=2]. His 14 Heart Event is broken up into three parts. There is also an introduction event and a few extra events.[/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][b][i]Argenti's Shop![/i][/b][/size][/*]
[/list]  [size=2]﻿Argenti runs a little stall in town that sells flowers! It's open Wednesday - Friday from 10 AM - 6 PM. This changes slightly when married.[/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][b][i]Argenti's House![/i][/b][/size][/*]
[/list]  ﻿[size=2]Argenti's cottage is located in the forest, near the bottom of the lake. It requires 2 hearts with him to enter.
﻿ ﻿In the configs, there is an option to change the position of his house just in case it conflicts with any other mods you have, or you simply don't like the position. [/size]

[list]
[*][b][i][size=3]White-Haired Argenti Option![/size][/i][/b][/*]
[/list][size=2]  ﻿Adds more white to Argenti's hair in his sprites and portraits, for the people who headcanon that he originally had white hair. [i]Default: Off
[/i][/size]
[list]
[*][b][i][size=3]Safe Mode![/size][/i][/b][/*]
[/list][size=2]  ﻿A few lines of Argenti's dialogue after marriage imply or reference intimacy between him and the farmer. Turning on Safe Mode replaces those lines. [i]Default: Off


[/i][/size][u]To Be Added:[/u]
[list]
[*][i][b]Festival Outfits![/b] [/i][size=1](The rest of them)[/size][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b][i]More Extra Events![/i][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][i]Maybe more idk[/i][/b][/size][/*]
[/list]
[left][/left]
[center]﻿~~
[/center]
Included in the mod folder is a .txt filed named "Spoilers". Inside that file is Argenti's gift preferences, event requirements, etc.

[center]﻿~~
[/center]
Mods present in the screenshots are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12831]Dynamic Reflections[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]
